lamps.lamp: Immobilizer/Keyless Push Start System Warning Light
lamps.steady: There is a problem with the system. Have it inspected by a Maruti Suzuki workshop.
lamps.flashing: The engine will not start. This happens if there is a system error or the remote is not in the vehicle.

lamps.steady: One or more tyres are significantly under-inflated. Stop and check your tyres as soon as possible.
lamps.flashing: There is a malfunction with the TPMS. Have the system inspected by a Maruti Suzuki workshop.

lamps.steady: Parking brake is engaged, brake fluid is low, or the system has failed. Stop safely and check the brakes.
There is a problem with the ABS. Braking will function normally but without the anti-lock feature.
Insufficient oil pressure. Pull off the road as soon as possible and stop the engine.
There is a malfunction in the ESP systems. Have the system inspected by a Maruti Suzuki workshop.
lamps.flashing: Stability or traction control is currently activated. Drive carefully.

lamps.steady: The ESP systems have been manually turned off.
The engine is still cold. The light goes off when the engine warms up.
lamps.flashing: There is a problem with the system. Have the vehicle inspected by a Maruti Suzuki workshop.

lamps.lamp: High engine coolant temperature warning light
lamps.steady: The engine is overheating. Stop and follow overheating instructions immediately.
lamps.flashing: The engine is running hot. Avoid driving conditions that lead to overheating.

lamps.steady: There is a problem with the battery charging system. Have it inspected immediately.
The driver or front passenger has not buckled their seat belt.
lamps.flashing: The seat belt remains unbuckled while driving.

lamps.lamp: Rear Passenger Seat Belt Reminder Light
lamps.steady: Reminds rear passengers to fasten their seat belts.
Problem with the airbag or seat belt pretensioner. Systems may not work properly during a collision.
There is a problem with the emission control system or automatic transmission. Have the vehicle serviced.
lamps.flashing: Engine misfire detected. Stop immediately in a safe place to prevent damage to the catalyst.

lamps.steady: There is a problem with the automatic transmission system. Have it inspected by a Maruti Suzuki workshop.
One or more doors or the tailgate are not completely closed.
The fuel level is low. Refuel the tank as soon as possible.
Position lights, tail lights, or headlights are turned on.
The front fog lights are currently operating.
The engine has stopped automatically.
lamps.flashing: The driver's door was opened or the seat belt unfastened while the engine was auto-stopped.

lamps.steady: The ENG A-STOP system has been manually turned off.
lamps.flashing: System malfunction, battery replacement needed, or lithium-ion battery issue. Inspect vehicle immediately.
The turn signals or hazard warning lights are currently operating.
Remote controller not sensed or battery is low. Engine cannot start normally.

lamps.steady: The cruise control system is turned on.
The cruising speed is set and maintained.

lamps.lamp: Remote Controller Battery Consumption Warning Light
lamps.steady: The remote controller battery is nearly discharged.
